title: Helium Prices Hit 4x When Supply Tightened
hook: Helium prices hit 4x when supply tightened.
closing: Concentrated reserves and rising demand can make essential helium costlier.
question: Have helium balloons gotten pricier?

segments.say: Qatar holds 10.1 billion cubic meters of helium reserves. Global supply depends heavily on a few countries.
Projected helium demand reaches a 190 index. More buyers will chase a limited resource.
The helium price index reached 400 during the crunch. Tight supply made costs surge.
